tanya: Quick canary check for v7.0-int4 bring-up on mixed-workload (8k queries). posting topline then artifacts.
hiro: TL;DR?
tanya: p50=48ms, p95=200ms. cost ~=0.37x fp16 baseline. global_concordance delta = -0.35% (n=8k). doc-cohesion slice delta = -1.6% (n=1.05k), CI [-2.1%, -1.1%], p=0.015.
sam: doc-cohesion -1.6% is right at our slice gate. do we have the policy details?
canary-bot: Policy lookup: canary.policy.v2 -> slice_threshold=-0.015, global_threshold=-0.008, min_samples=1000, require_pvalue<0.05.
tanya: that means the slice_threshold is breached and p<0.05, so auto-fallback condition satisfied.
hiro: hold on before auto-fallback fires: can we rule out metric aliasing (we've seen "cohesion_score" vs "doc_cohesion" before) and sample-skew?
tanya: checked mapping  eval emitted metric key `doc_cohesion`. sample counts per slice: doc-cohesion 1050, short-qa 3.1k, code 450. no aliasing.
sam: runtime notes? any KV warmup or kernel differences across hosts?
eng-bot: Canary run recorded kernels: 30% hosts -> int4-kernel-accelerated-v6, 70% -> int4-kernel-stable-v4. KV warmup rates normal.
hiro: good call. can you repro with kernel split locally?
tanya: running microbench: group-A (v6) n=1.2k doc-cohesion queries -> delta ~-2.1%. group-B (v4) same queries -> delta ~-0.4%. strong correlation with kernel v6.
sam: plan: 1) pause promotion 2) pin canary hosts to stable kernel 3) rollback route if any live traffic 4) run focused stratified A/B with doc-cohesion oversample (n=3k) 5) open kernel audit ticket.
tanya: initiating rollback + kernel pin: /rollout rollback --model v7.0-int4 --reason "doc_cohesion -1.6% triggered; kernel v6 correlated"
eng-bot: Rollout acknowledged. Routing set to v6.9-fp16 within 80s. Kernel pin: host-label kernel_preference=int4-stable-v4 applied to canary pool.
hiro: artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/1869993333/v7.0-int4-smoke-8k.jsonl. perf traces uploaded: https://redwood.internal/evals/1869993333/traces.zip
sam: Incident INC-2026-0601 created for canary auto-fallback (doc_cohesion slice). Assigned: tanya, hiro. SLA: 72h.
tanya: uploading top-100 failing examples and kernel-diff to the ticket. will also draft a policy addendum: require kernel-consistency check (>=90% same kernel across canary hosts) as part of preflight.
hiro: +1 on kernel-consistency. will also add a metric-alias sanity check so missing keys fail preflight.
tanya: will follow up with post-triage notes in this thread. :thumbsup:
